description: Filling an input's #[KeyOf(User::class)] assignee from a <Select> with Number(value) fails tsc: a select's value is a string, and Number() makes it a plain number, which no model's key is.

expect.errorContains: error TS2322: Type 'number | null' is not assignable to type '(number & { readonly [keyOf]: "User.id"; }) | null'.
